blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY, BOHOL, Philippines — Bohol Gov. Erico Aristotle “Aris” Aumentado has called on tourism operators and stakeholders to ensure that the province’s growing tourism industry benefits not only large establishments but also ordinary Boholanos. Aumentado issued the call on Tuesday amid renewed public discussion over tourism prices in Bohol, sparked by a viral post about a P1,650 pompano dish served at a resort in Panglao.
